snippet.title: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door ENCORE - Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the GameBanana page HERE!!!
https://gamebanana.com/mods/590058



Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door Encore is a full game reimagining intended for subsequent playthroughs! The mod is designed to add a creative spark to the game while still maintaining its iconic charm. Welcome back to Rogueport!

Encore is designed for people who have already finished the base game. This mod is balanced under the assumption that the player is already familiar with Paper Mario. The X-Nauts aren't pulling their punches this time! Are you up to the challenge?

Featuring...
    Expert-level difficulty!!!
    Rearranged item locations!
    Brand new party skillset!
    Full-scale rebalancing!
    Reimagined dungeons & progression!
    Strategic enemy formations!
    Exclusive enemy variants!
    Relentless bosses!
    Multiple difficulties!
AND MORE!!!

Trailer was edited by the very talented Gravity, who is also my brother! Check out his other stuff HERE!!!
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkHi2WYX6mYHQvxfXsMSN2w
